listings.name: Dietwise
listings.address: Level 2, 448 Fitzgerald St, North Perth WA 6006
listings.blurb: A team practice on Fitzgerald Street led by principal dietitian Sonya Douglas, working across eating disorders, digestive and women's health, autism and ADHD, chronic conditions, sports nutrition and NDIS support. Open six days with telehealth available, no referral needed, and supermarket tours for people who want the theory made practical.
listings._source: dietwise.net.au — address, phone, email, team, services, hours confirmed; fees tiered but not published

listings.name: Intuitry
listings.address: Mount Lawley WA 6050 (also Kalamunda & North Perth)
listings.blurb: Non-diet dietitians specialising in eating disorder recovery, with a weight-neutral, Health-at-Every-Size approach and credentialed eating-disorder clinicians on the team. Consults run $105–$240 depending on length and clinician, with Medicare rebates under eating disorder and chronic disease plans.
listings._source: intuitry.com.au — team, credentials, full fee schedule, contact confirmed; street address not published, suburb-level only

listings.name: Nutrition Nation
listings.address: 9 Leura Ave, Claremont WA 6010 (PROmotion Health; also Applecross & Wembley rooms)
listings.blurb: A dietitian team consulting from Claremont with additional rooms in Applecross and Wembley, focused on fertility, PCOS and endometriosis, gut health and IBS (Monash low-FODMAP trained), diabetes and cardiovascular health. Telehealth Australia-wide, private health rebates, and Medicare rebates with a GP care plan.
listings._source: nutritionnation.com.au — locations, team credentials, specialties, contact confirmed; fees not published

listings.name: Perth Performance Nutrition
listings.address: Consults at Recwell recovery & wellness centre, Perth WA
listings.blurb: Clare Keating is an accredited practising dietitian and sports dietitian consulting in person at Recwell and online by video across Australia. Individual consultations and personalised meal plans sit alongside workshops for sporting clubs and businesses — a natural fit for anyone training seriously who wants the fuelling side handled properly.
listings._source: perthperformancenutrition.com.au — practitioner, credentials, services, email confirmed; RECWELL VENUE SUBURB NEEDS VERIFYING before publish; fees not published

listings.name: Nutrition Works
listings.address: Lathlain WA 6100 (also Midland & Mt Claremont rooms)
listings.blurb: A sports-nutrition-leaning dietitian team consulting from Lathlain, Midland and Mt Claremont, including an advanced sports dietitian with more than twenty years in the field. Strong on endurance sport, adolescent athletes and gut health, with hydration testing and supermarket tour groups alongside standard consultations.
